messages:
Riya Banerjee: Quick — we're packaging a one-page preflight for three renewal-risk customers. Need fillable fields + three runnable checks (cache hit, batch loop, streaming smoke) and a tiny telemetry checklist for AMs. Keep it short and copy-paste friendly.

Zack Nguyen: Agreed. Form + three commands. Add thresholds inline so engs know when to flag: cache_hit < 30% = candidate for prefix caching; p95 > 600ms = ops review; error_rate > 1% = escalate.

Marta Ruiz: For streaming guidance: recommend enable when median > 300ms or p95 > 450ms. For UI interaction flows, batch_size 1-4 and low concurrency. Include a minimal JSON config they can paste back to us.

eng_bot: Pro tip: run `/autofill-metrics <account>` to populate cache_hit and p95 automatically.

Theo Martin: Pasteable email form (one-liners):
---
CUSTOMER PREFLIGHT (please complete)
- Account name:
- Eng contact (name/email):
- Endpoint(s)/routes impacted:
- Cache approach (prefix/response/shared KV):
- Cache TTLs observed (s):
- Cache hit % (7d):
- batch_size (min/max):
- streaming enabled? (y/n):
- p95 latency (24h):
- error rate (24h):
- recent config changes (14d):
- priority flows (1-3):
---

Zack Nguyen: Runnable checks to paste: 
1) streaming smoke test:
```
curl -s -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Prefer: streaming=1" -d '{"input":"hello","stream":true}' https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate
```
2) simple latency loop (bash):
```
for i in {1..15}; do time curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"ping"}' https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate; done
```
3) cache header check:
```
curl -I -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate | grep -i cache
```

Marta Ruiz: Minimal config snippet to paste to us:
```
{"cache_prefix":"acct-123","cache_ttl_secs":1800,"batch_size":4,"enable_streaming":true}
```

Riya Banerjee: Add a one-line signal->AM action mapping: low cache_hit -> suggest prefix caching + schedule 30m tune; rising p95 -> ops deep-dive; billing disputes -> finance contact. Keep it on the one-pager.

Theo Martin: I'll assemble a single-page PDF + a plain-text email snippet. Will post draft here in ~2h. Tag me if you want tweaks.

eng_bot: Created ticket CS-PREF-7744 assigned to Theo Martin.

Zack Nguyen: I'll drop Node/Python smoke tests into the samples repo once the PDF is live.

Riya Banerjee: Thanks team — this will make renewal outreach way less back-and-forth.
